deep.reconstruction: There is no mathematics on this page. It is a handwritten title page, a draft or fair copy, for Riemann's Göttingen doctoral dissertation. It reads: 'Grundlagen für eine allgemeine Theorie der Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Grösse. Eine Abhandlung von B. Riemann, zu deren öffentlicher Vertheidigung behuf Erlangung der Doctorwürde der Verfasser bereit sein wird am 16. Dec. 1851, 11 Uhr 30 Min. Vormittags. Göttingen 1851.' In English: 'Foundations for a general theory of functions of one variable complex quantity. A dissertation by B. Riemann, which the author will be ready to defend publicly in order to obtain the doctoral degree, on 16 Dec. 1851, 11:30 a.m. Göttingen 1851.' The page serves as the formal announcement or cover of the Inaugural-Dissertation. Its content (Cauchy–Riemann equations, conformal mapping, Riemann surfaces, Dirichlet principle, Riemann mapping theorem) is in the following pages of the printed work, not here. There are no derivations to reconstruct and no implicit steps to supply. The archive folio number '102' is pencilled in the right margin.

results.what: Title page of the 1851 doctoral dissertation 'Grundlagen für eine allgemeine Theorie der Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Grösse', with the stated date and time of the public defence (16 Dec 1851, 11:30 a.m.).

deep.surprise_reason: This is simply the title page of Riemann's well-known 1851 dissertation. The title and the defence date of 16 December 1851 match the published record. It contains no mathematics.
transcription_corrections: The manuscript spelling is probably 'Grösse' (long-s/s ligature) rather than the modernised 'Größe'.
The author's initial is hard to read in the hand and could be taken for 'L.'. 'B. Riemann' is consistent with the printed title page and is very likely correct.
Otherwise the transcription matches the image: 'behuf Erlangung der Doctorwürde', 'am 16. Dec. 1851', '11 Uhr 30 Min. Vormittags', 'Göttingen 1851'.
Archive folio number '102' appears in the right margin (not part of the text).
